bounds.domain: One known save-copy identity, one writing or saved receipt, zero or one unique owned MediaStore row, pending/published/absent state, and confirmed or unconfirmed cleanup.
bounds.assumptions: Recovery sees pending rows explicitly. Confirmed cleanup removes exactly its pending row before writing failure. A failed provider read or cleanup stays unconfirmed. No fairness is assumed; callers need not retry.
bounds.limitations: No concurrent provider row replacement, ambiguous duplicate names, preference durability failure or image encoding is modeled. The source-level JVM check covers unavailable lookup, ambiguous rows and failed cleanup; Android consumer instrumentation checks actual pending visibility and deletion. Replace-original recovery and its retained backups are unchanged.
